How to Obtain[]

Characters are primarily obtained by performing Wishes using Intertwined Fates or Acquaint Fates. These Wishing Items can be:

  • Purchased with Primogems.
  • Earned from Events and Quests.
  • Exchanged with Masterless Starglitter ×5 each in the Paimon's Bargains shop.
  • Exchanged for a monthly limit with Masterless Stardust ×75 each in the Paimon's Bargains shop.

Other ways to obtain characters include:

  • Account Creation
    • The Traveler is the only character at the start of the game, who cannot be obtained elsewhere.
  • Archon Quests
    • Amber, Kaeya, and Lisa are obtained during the Archon Quest Prologue: Act I - The Outlander Who Caught the Wind automatically.
  • Beginners' Wish
    • Noelle is a guaranteed character in the first 10-wish set.
  • Paimon's Bargains
    • Two 4-star characters can be purchased from the monthly Paimon's Bargains shop in exchange for Masterless Starglitter ×34 each.
  • Flagship Events
  • Permanent Events
    • Barbara is obtained by completing the Archon Quest A Long Shot in Prologue: Act III - Song of the Dragon and Freedom through Baptism of Song in the event menu.
    • Lynette is obtained by reaching Adventure Rank 25 through The Curtain Never Falls on Magic in the event menu.
    • Xiangling is obtained by completing Floor 3, Chamber 3 through People's Choice.
    • Collei is obtained by completing Floor 4, Chamber 3 through Curtain of Leaves.
    • Kachina is obtained by completing step 3 in the Archon Quest Natlan! A New Adventure in Chapter V: Act I - Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn automatically. Requirements can be seen in Turbo Twirly! in the event menu.
    • Aino is obtained by completing step 16 in the Archon Quest Where the Moon Rises in Song of the Welkin Moon: Act I - A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves automatically. Requirements can be seen in The Clink Clank Whiz-Kid! in the event menu.
    • Alyosha is obtained by completing step 2 in the Archon Quest Gunfire in the Silent Lands in Chapter VII: Act I - Everwinter Without Mercy automatically. Requirements can be seen in The Hunt Begins! in the event menu.
    • Razor, Fischl, or Sucrose can be obtained after completing the tutorial quest Witch's Homework: Solution, in the event menu through Witch's Homework. Only one of these three characters can be obtained here.
  • Miliastra Wonderland
    • The Wonderland Manekins are obtained by unlocking this mode. Both characters are obtained, but one of them must be picked and customized in order to progress, while the other Manekin that wasn't picked can be customized later.
  • Aloy was obtained through Mail from September 2021 to November 2021:
    • PlayStation: September 1, 2021 to October 13, 2021
    • PC and Mobile: October 13, 2021 to November 24, 2021

Progression[]

Leveling[]

Main article: Character EXP

Characters gain Character EXP primarily by using Character EXP Materials, as well as negligible amounts of experience for defeating monsters.

The Archon Quests in the Prologue - Wanderer's Trail, Act I - The Outlander Who Caught the Wind and Act II - For a Tomorrow Without Tears of the Prologue also reward Character EXP.

Ascensions[]

See also: Character Ascension and Character Ascension Stat

Characters can be ascended to their next ascension phase once they reach their current max level and the player has the required Adventure Rank. Characters can be ascended up to 8 times (up to Lv. 100).

To ascend a character, go to the character screen and click on the Ascend button at the bottom-right of the Character Menu. A box will appear, showing which Character Level-Up Materials, Character Ascension Materials, Local Specialties, and Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials are needed, and the Mora cost required to ascend the character. If there is an item missing, click on it to see various ways to obtain it. See each character's page for the materials needed for each ascension.

Upon reaching the 1st and 4th ascension, the character unlocks their 1st and 2nd passive combat talents respectively. The 3rd passive utility talent (available to all characters, except the Traveler) is already unlocked without any ascensions.

On the 2nd ascension, the character gains a special flat bonus attribute boost, either for one of their base attributes (e.g., the Traveler gains a bonus to their ATK value) or a special attribute (e.g., Ningguang gains a Geo DMG Bonus while Lisa gains an Elemental Mastery bonus). This bonus further increases upon the 3rd, 5th, and 6th ascension.

Ascending characters to their 1st, 3rd, and 5th phase will reward the player with one Acquaint Fate.

Ascending characters to their 7th and 8th ascensions require one Masterless Stella Fortuna and two Masterless Stella Fortuna respectively. The character's level will instantly increase to the next level cap upon ascension.

Talents[]

Main article: Talent

Most characters have a total of 3 Combat Talents and 3 Passive Talents. Combat Talents, which include Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst, and can be leveled from Lv. 1 to Lv. 10, while Passive Talents, which include 1st Ascension Passive, 4th Ascension Passive, Utility Passive, cannot be leveled. Increasing the level can increase the scaling and effects of Combat Talents.

Constellations[]

Main article: Constellation

Each character has a total of 6 Constellations, which are similar to their Passive Talents and increase the effectiveness of the character or add new capabilities.

In order to unlock each Constellation of a character, a player must use a Stella Fortuna for that specific character. Players can obtain a character's Stella Fortuna by wishing a duplicate of the character in Wishes or buying the character from Paimon's Bargains. The Traveler's Constellations are unique in that they are unlocked not through the above systems, but through Archon Quests, Adventure Rank Rewards (Anemo only), by offering Oculi to Statue of The Seven (Electro, Dendro, Hydro) and Souvenir Shops instead.

When receiving a Stella Fortuna for a 5-Star character already at their maximum Constellation level, a Masterless Stella Fortuna is given instead which can be used to ascend any character to their 7th and 8th ascensions.

Total Materials Required[]

The total amount of materials required to level a character from Level 1 to 100 is:

  • 2,092,000 Mora (1,672,000 for leveling up and 420,000 for Ascension)
  • 8,362,650 Character EXP (415× Hero's Wit, 11× Adventurer's Experience, 12× Wanderer's Advice)
  • 432× Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials (18× , 30× , 36× )
  • 168× Local Specialties
  • 46× Normal Boss Materials
  • 271× Ascension Gems (1× , 9× , 9× , 6× )
  • 3× Masterless Stella Fortuna (Level 90-100 only)

The total amount of materials required to level all three Combat Talents from Talent Level 1 to 10 is:

  • 4,956,000 Mora
  • 1,053× Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials (18× , 66× , 93× )
  • 1,224× Talent Books (9× , 63× , 114× )
  • 18× Weekly Boss Materials
  • 3× Crowns of Insight

The grand total is:

  • 7,048,000 Mora
  • 8,362,650 Character EXP (415× Hero's Wit, 11× Adventurer's Experience, 12× Wanderer's Advice)
  • 1,485× Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials (36× , 96× , 129× )
  • 168× Local Specialties
  • 46× Normal Boss Materials
  • 271× Ascension Gems (1× , 9× , 9× , 6× )
  • 1,224× Talent Books (9× , 63× , 114× )
  • 18× Weekly Boss Materials

Trivia[]

  • Characters say their related voice lines based on the weather and time of day in the open world. (e.g., When It Rains)
  • Characters say their "More About" Voice-Overs when their Friendship Level increases.
  • Characters are healed to their Max HP after their level is increased or they are ascended. This can occur even when in combat.
  • Every other Flagship Event gives the player a free 4-star Character. The free 4-star reward sequence is adjusted at the start of each new Version to ensure the Flagship Event that corresponds with Lantern Rites allows for the free 4-star Liyue character selector. Version 1 was an exception as Version 1.0 did not have a Flagship Event.
  • Version 3.8 marks the first time a new Version did not add any new Character.
